source: ops/gain/r530/bank/<task_id>/rubric.md 的共用段（20 題逐位元相同；逐題的 worked examples 不在內）

levels.1: Names carry no meaning; no comments and none would help; a single function runs past 80 lines
levels.2: Readable only by tracing execution by hand; names abbreviated past recognition
levels.3: Names roughly say what they hold; the shape is followable but a few passages need re-reading
levels.4: Reads straight through with one or two pauses; comments mostly explain "why"
levels.5: Reads once and is understood; names use the same words as the contract; comments appear only where "why" is not obvious from the code

levels.1: Everything in one function or one tangle; the pieces cannot be moved
levels.2: Split exists but each piece knows the internals of the others
levels.3: Split exists but boundaries are arbitrary; duplicated logic appears twice or more
levels.4: Clear units, at most one seam that feels accidental
levels.5: One responsibility per unit; no duplicated logic; adding one new rule means editing one place

levels.1: Exception messages do not say what went wrong; or a bare `except:` swallows failures
levels.2: Errors surface but as the wrong type, or the message names the module rather than the input
levels.3: Every exception the contract asks for is raised, message acceptable
levels.4: Messages name the offending input in most paths
levels.5: Every exception the contract asks for is raised; messages name which part of the input is at fault; nothing is swallowed; the normal path is not written as exception flow

levels.1: What it does does not line up with the trouble the goal describes
levels.2: Only the happy path from the goal is addressed
levels.3: The contract is met, but only part of the trouble in the goal is handled
levels.4: Nearly all of the goal's trouble is visibly handled
levels.5: Every piece of trouble named in the goal has something visible in the code that answers it
